locator: I q.3 a.8 co.: Tertio, quia nulla pars compositi potest esse simpliciter prima in entibus
interpretation: Third reason why God cannot enter into the composition of anything: no part of a composite, neither matter (in potency, posterior to act) nor a participated form, can be simply first among beings, and God is 'primum ens simpliciter'. 'Simply first among beings' is read as maximal in being, the quarta via's maxime ens; that identification is the interpretive step. Components are the ComponentOf of q.3 a.7. The first two reasons (from God as first efficient cause) are not formalized.
